literal_meaning: মৃদু কম্পন বা থিরথির করে কাঁপার শব্দানুকরণ
figurative_meaning_en: mild trembling or shivering, often due to fear or cold
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভয়ে তার শরীরে থির-থিরানি শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Fear made his body start to shiver uncontrollably.
He was shivering from the cold.
note: This idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking the sound of light trembling, commonly used in everyday Bengali speech.
